reviews.reasons: EXECUTABLE is supported. The member (HACCP reassessment packs, cop_1f14190b29964326a5e7) has every link on EVIDENCE facts of its own record: 140 licensed plants with published QA contacts, 100 unquoted, each reassessing at least annually; a real purchase price (this service's last 10 accepted quotes paid at $1,400, invoices Oct-Nov 2026); conversion measured on this offer's own quotes to the same licence list (10/40 = 25%); Brain fulfils (PRODUCE_SPREADSHEET proved); $30 cost; $0 exposure. Recomputed with Nov 28 = day 0: quotes Nov 29 (day 1), acceptances within 4 days (day 5), delivery within 4 days (Dec 7, day 9), net 10 (Dec 17, day 19) of 21. 6 x $1,400 = $8,400 >= $6,000; only 5 wins are actually needed ($7,000), i.e. 5% of 100 vs 25% measured (~25 expected; lower bound of 10/40 still ~15). Capital $180 against the $5,000 ceiling. Ledger matches steps and trace. Exclusions are correct: the plate freezer needs $12,000 paid up front (exposure fact) over the $5,000 ceiling; the fish-offcut load pays net 45 from a Dec 4 delivery (~Jan 18, 51 days) after the 21-day window.
findings: Recomputed: $8,400 gross, $180 cost, $8,220 net; 5 wins suffice for the target; proof day 19 of 21.

Timing is the tight link: only 2 days of slack between net-10 settlement (day 19) and the window end (day 21). One plant paying 3+ days late loses that deal's cash, though with ~25 expected wins vs 5 needed the target still holds unless lateness is systematic.
Excluded freezer resale: $12,000 up-front > $5,000 exposure cap - a real constraint even with all evidence. Excluded offcut broker: settlement ~day 51 > 21. Both correct.
Operational note: SEND_A_MESSAGE and ISSUE_AN_INVOICE are NOT_CONNECTED; quotes must go out on day 1 and invoices on delivery day 9, or the 2-day slack is consumed.
